text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Welcome to the Tokyo Daishoten—the final hurrah to round off this year's dirt races! We've got more spectators this time around ready to see a fierce showdown!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …This race is Inari's last goal of the year.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Let's see her through it, as fellow racers from the same generation.

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: I didn't expect Oguri Cap and Super Creek to come and see the Tokyo Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: And they're here for Inari One? Is she that much of an important runner to them?

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm sure Inari One saw Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross battle it out at the Arima Kinen. I wonder if that'll affect what she brings to the table today… We'll have to keep an eye on her.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe, enough to ask ya how best to get rid of these shivers.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But I plan on wrappin' up this finale with a bang.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So keep your eyes peeled for the moment I take the top of the regionals!
choice_data_list: I wouldn't miss it for anything!
I wouldn't miss it for anything!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey. Some time's past since the Japan Dirt Derby, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Oi Racer
text_block_list.text: …I expected this much from ya. Ya look poised to cut me down any second. That's the Inari One I know.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …You're pretty amazing yourself. You're completely different from when I last saw ya.

text_block_list.name: Oi Racer
text_block_list.text: I'm not the only one. Everyone here's staked their lives on a chance to get to the top.

text_block_list.name: Oi Racer
text_block_list.text: Let's see who's got more Oi spirit flowing in 'em!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It's on! You're gonna have front row seats to seein' my climb to the top!
